posts.title: The Painted Church
posts.description: Aka All Saints' Cambridge . Just opposite Jesus. Has a pottery exhibition until December the 6th. We visited on a gray day and the interior was gloomy; it might well look better on a sunnier day. The interior is painted, likely from stencils; there are William Morris-ish associations.
